title: Resettlement and Integration
excerpt: %%project_excerpt%% – A community-led initiative by Rohingya Centre of UK (RCUK) supporting education, resilience and humanitarian action.
content:
Resettlement and Integration

We stand by resettled refugees from the moment they arrive, offering unwavering support.

Integration Program

As part of the learning the Integration program aims to help the new arrival assimilate into British society by offering:

  • Cultural Orientation: Workshops and seminars that educate participants about British culture, customs, and societal norms.
  • Legal and Social Guidance: Assistance with understanding and navigating the UK’s legal and social systems, including access to healthcare, education, and housing.
  • Employment Support: Job search assistance, resume writing workshops, and vocational training to improve employability.
  • Community Building Activities: Events and initiatives designed to foster a sense of community and belonging, encouraging social interaction and mutual support among Rohingya individuals and other community members.

title: Education: A Rohingya-Led Global Initiative
excerpt: Join us in empowering Rohingya children with quality, accredited education and vocational training. Partner with us for a brighter future.
content:
Education: A Rohingya-Led Global Initiative

At the Rohingya Centre of the United Kingdom (RCUK), we are proud to spearhead the Rohingya Education Board (REB)—a groundbreaking initiative dedicated to establishing a centralised education system that blends digital and in-person learning.

Our goal is to provide Rohingya children with internationally accredited education tailored to their unique needs. We aim to offer recognised qualifications, vocational training, and a curriculum that honors Rohingya language and heritage, all while preparing students for a brighter future.

We are seeking partnerships with educational institutions, NGOs, and global organisations to bring this vision to life. Together, we can build an education system that not only equips Rohingya children with essential skills but also provides them with hope and opportunity for a brighter future.

Partner with us to make a lasting impact on one of the world’s most vulnerable communities.

Explore our mission further and learn how you can support the REB in its journey to create lasting, impactful change for generations to come.

ESOL Courses

ESOL Program

Our ESOL program is designed to provide Rohingya and other individuals with the language skills necessary to communicate effectively in English. This program includes:

  • Basic to Advanced English Classes: Tailored to meet the varying levels of English proficiency among participants, from beginners to more advanced learners.
  • Conversational Practice: Focused sessions that encourage everyday communication, helping participants to become more confident in speaking and understanding English.
  • Language Certification: Providing opportunities to obtain recognised qualifications that can aid in employment and further education.

title: Children Activities
excerpt: %%project_excerpt%% – A community-led initiative by Rohingya Centre of UK (RCUK) supporting education, resilience and humanitarian action.
content:
Children Activities

We recognise the importance of supporting children and young people through tailored children’s activities. These programs are designed to promote educational development, cultural integration, and emotional well-being among children. By providing a safe and nurturing environment, RCUK aims to help children thrive and build a brighter future.

Educational Support

  • Homework Clubs: After-school sessions where children receive assistance with their homework, fostering a supportive learning environment.
  • Language Classes: Special English language classes designed for children to improve their proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English.

Cultural and Recreational Activities

  • Art and Craft Sessions: Creative workshops where children can express themselves through various art forms, helping to develop their creativity and fine motor skills.
  • Cultural Celebrations: Events that celebrate both Rohingya and British cultural traditions, helping children appreciate their heritage while integrating into British society.
  • Sports and Games: Regular physical activities and sports programs that promote teamwork, physical health, and confidence.

Holiday and Summer Camps

  • Holiday Camps: Engaging activities during school holidays that combine fun and learning, ensuring children have a constructive and enjoyable break.
  • Summer Camps: Week-long camps that offer a variety of activities, from educational workshops to outdoor adventures, providing a memorable experience for children.

Employment Support

We offers complete employment support and training in employability skills. We collaborate with wide range of district employers in Bradford to align their job openings with individuals in local communities. Our focus is on assisting the long-term unemployed, particularly those new arrival refugees and migrants in the city, help them with job placements to foster learning about the labour market.

Our employment support services include:

  • Job club sessions
  • Job search facilities
  • Interview preparation
  • Access to training programs and courses
  • Enterprise training initiatives
  • Basic skills training including ESOL and IT proficiency
  • Personalised one-to-one mentoring and coaching

title: Welcome to Bradford
excerpt: %%project_excerpt%% – A community-led initiative by Rohingya Centre of UK (RCUK) supporting education, resilience and humanitarian action.
content:
Welcome to Bradford

Welcome to Bradford!

Our Welcome to Bradford program is tailored to support newcomers as they navigate and settle into their new home in our city. We understand that starting fresh in a new place can be overwhelming, and our dedicated team is here to help make the transition as smooth as possible.

From finding suitable accommodation to accessing essential services like healthcare and education, we provide guidance and assistance every step of the way. Our program offers a range of support services designed to meet the unique needs of newcomers, whether you’re a refugee, asylum seeker, or someone relocating for other reasons.

We also offer community orientation sessions to help you become familiar with Bradford’s diverse culture, amenities, and resources. Additionally, we can connect you with local support networks and organisations where you can meet others and build meaningful connections within the community.

At Welcome to Bradford, we believe in the power of community and the importance of creating a welcoming environment for all. We are committed to helping you feel at home in Bradford and supporting you as you embark on this new chapter in your life. Welcome to Bradford – we’re here to help you thrive!
